title: Album / collection
one_line: Everything you own and everything you do not, as a grid with completion - the bottom nav's own destination, not a duplicate of the shop's owned filter.

anatomy.spec: Same categories as the shop: DICE / TOKENS / EMOJIS.
A progress bar per category: '6 / 14 owned'.
Same card chassis as the shop (bible 5.17), owned full-colour, unowned silhouetted/locked, tapping either opens shop-item-detail.

states: Nothing owned yet in a category - empty state, not a wall of locked cards with no explanation
motion: Completion bar animates in on tab open.
data: Ownership from the same source as the shop - never a second list that can drift out of sync.
do_not: Do not duplicate the shop's card data separately - one source of truth for ownership.
Do not let this become a second shop with buy buttons - it is a collection view, tapping opens detail which can then offer to buy.
acceptance: Completion numbers match what the shop shows as owned.
steps: 2. Rebuild/build on the hub chassis with bg_menu_emboss.
3. Reuse the shop's card component for consistency.
4. Wire completion bars per category to the shared ownership source.
prompt:
Rebuild the Ludo NX Album / collection hub.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 5.17 and 5.12, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

Swap the ground to bg_menu_emboss and build it on the same card chassis as the Shop (screens/shop.json) so owned and unowned items look consistent between the two screens. Add a folder tab per category (DICE / TOKENS / EMOJIS) with a completion progress bar ('6 / 14 owned'), and reuse the shop's ownership data as the single source of truth - never a second list that can drift.

Tapping any card, owned or not, opens the item detail popup rather than turning this into a second shop with its own buy buttons.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
